findings.title: Publish the widened operation type as a major release. `EncryptOperation.getOperation().plaintext` changed from `Plaintext | null` to `PlaintextInput | null`. `
findings.label: valid
findings.note: getOperation() on the exported EncryptOperation now returns plaintext: PlaintextInput | null (encrypt.ts:136), where PlaintextInput = Plaintext | JsonDocument, so the output type widens in a release labeled patch and consumers assigning it to Plaintext | null can break.
